stage_1_description: You just arrived at the monastery. You smell like git blame.
stage_2_description: You made your first commit. The monks noticed.
stage_3_description: A faint path appears. Try not to git lost.
stage_4_description: You can see the mountain. It looks... steep.
stage_5_description: The Head Monk gave you a robe. It's itchy.
stage_6_description: You know what staging means. Most people never get here.
stage_7_description: Climbing through the forest of branches.
stage_8_description: Above the treeline. You can see the merge conflicts from here.
stage_9_description: The air thins. Your commits are getting cleaner.
stage_10_description: You craft commits like a monk crafts silence.
stage_11_description: Halfway up. The clouds are below you now.
stage_12_description: The path narrows. You don't even flinch.
stage_13_description: Other monks ask you for directions. Terrifying.
stage_14_description: You see patterns in the chaos of merge conflicts.
stage_15_description: The mountain hums. Or maybe that's the CI pipeline.
stage_16_description: You sense conflicts before they arise. Spooky.
stage_17_description: The commit graph speaks to you. You speak back.
stage_18_description: You interactive rebase without fear. Legend.
stage_19_description: The peak is within reach. Don't look down at your git log.
stage_20_description: Pure radiance. You ARE the repo. Gitvana achieved.
